digest.component_or_area: lean row projection across read backends
propositions: The lean discovery row retains four DSSE signature fields (authorship_ledger, attestations, signature, keyring) that comprise 88% of lean list bytes despite include_body=False dropping only description and comments
Two backends (list_states and TicketView.list_by_query) spell the lean row separately, allowing them to drift in which fields they project
Three surfaces narrow by caller default (CLI rebar list, MCP list_tickets, MCP ready_tickets) while the library default remains unchanged, creating a breaking change for those three only
Backend parity and consistent projection must be tested against real data with parent-bounded queries since TicketView.list_by_query raises UnsupportedPinnedQuery on parentless queries

The lean-vs-full measurement shows 4,928,872 B total (1,726 B/row) after widening projection versus 44,392,067 B before, a 9x reduction achieved by dropping the four signing fields along with the two body fields
The CLI drift probe (show-vs-list key set comparison) must be repaired to derive its expectation from signature material presence rather than hardcoded field lists
